what_happened: RUN-0017 (26.5 min): all four sub-studies on domains A (20 km) and B (30 km). Scenario fields: study-region origin fractions local/external = 0.57/0.43 (explicit E1), 0.78/0.22 (uniform boundary input), 0.52/0.48 (mixed); no_arrival external-to-local ratio 4.1e-6 (verified by the forward model). At 10% noise: 8-interior 5.3%/2.8%, 6-interior 19%/3.9%, 6+2 upwind 24%/2.1%. Equal budget (8 sensors): interior8 beat interior+upwind on total RMSE (lower in 14 of 18 pairs at 2% noise), local RMSE (17 of 18) but interior+upwind was lower on external RMSE (10 of 18) and external amplitude error. Strong prior (alpha=1e5) destroys recovery (amplitude errors 0.7-0.99); alpha=0 is close to the selected alpha at 2% noise. Confounded case: column cosine 0.991 between L1 and the collinear external source, flags rank_deficient and confounded:L1,E1c, effective rank 2, condition 14.9; total-field error stays small relative to decomposition error. Boundary input vs a localised plume: omitting E1 gives 0.257 of the peak as RMSE, adding a uniform or four-sector boundary basis only 0.250 — whole-side boundary input cannot represent a localised plume. Domain A vs B: study-field difference 0.9% (external-only) and 3.3% (mixed) of peak.
what_worked: Identifiability flags fire for the confounded and no-arrival cases without a prior hiding them; noise is set relative to a documented signal scale; alpha frozen on validation before the test ensemble; raw rows saved

what_happened: CORRECTION to S1 after the independent Opus review: the boundary-basis equivalence sub-study of RUN-0017 contained a coordinate bug (observation layout built in domain-A coordinates while the truth was sampled in domain B, whose study region is shifted by buffer_B-buffer_A), so most sensors read the wrong place and every fit returned L1=0. The statement 'whole-side boundary input cannot mimic a localised plume; 0.257 -> 0.250 of peak' is NOT supported and is withdrawn. On smoke settings with the layout corrected the reviewer found RMSE/peak 0.097 (local-only) vs 0.080 (uniform basis) vs 0.079 (four-side bases), i.e. the opposite direction. Also: the confounded diagnostics quoted in S1 (effective rank 2, rank_deficient) belong to the 30% noise level, not 2%; at 2% the only flag is confounded and the split is recovered; tangential faces were classified by floating-point round-off (v=1.2e-16), affecting the 90/180/270 degree rows of the wind sweep; the scale vector (1e5 µg/s, 0.05 µg/m3) acts as a prior width when alpha>0; the inversion is given the true temporal profiles. All other production numbers in S1 matched the CSVs. A fix worker and a clean-commit rerun (new run, variant experiment) are in progress; until then the recovery, domain-size and special-case tables stand with these caveats and the equivalence study does not.
what_worked: Review caught the defect before it entered any conclusion outside the repo

what_happened: Three runs. RUN-0048 never reached the cluster: the hpc.bundle size guard aborted the build because the working tree carried results/ (2.1 GB) and data/; recorded failed, no Slurm id. RUN-0049 (slurm 201810, node004) ran and exited 0 with both arithmetic checks passing, but collect imported 0 artifacts because the script wrote its output into the bundle source/ tree rather than the run dir. RUN-0050 (slurm 201811, node004) exited 0, both checks passed, and 2 artifacts came home with sha256 matching the cluster-side sidecar (0e143789...). sacct: partition defq, account railabs, AllocCPUS 2 for a 1-CPU request, MaxRSS 1688K against 2G requested, elapsed under one second.
what_worked: Research OS native path end to end: BatchMode SSH (2.2s), rsync upload with upload_verified true (all 6 files match), sbatch submission with job id and token receipt, execution on a compute node with RESEARCH_RUN_DIR and SLURM_* exported, exit-status capture, log and artifact retrieval, idempotent sync. The duplicate-submission guard and the submission receipt both exist on the cluster. Input identity held end to end: the config sha256 is identical locally and in the returned result. Failure reporting (nonzero exit on corrupted arithmetic) was verified locally for free.

interpretation: 500 m / dt 100 is PROVISIONALLY ADMISSIBLE for EXP-026 - meaning no evidence against it, NOT shown adequate. The defensible basis is narrow: at noise 0.05 the mesh-induced displacement is of the same order as or smaller than the resampling spread, and dt 100 vs 50 is exactly a no-op (consistent with stage 1 finding dt error about one eighth of mesh error). The stability test itself, the held-out comparison and the noise 0.15 zeros support nothing. A negative mesh regret of -6.8 to -11.5 percent of J_ref bounds greedy sub-optimality at >=7-12 percent at the reference mesh, so regret partly measures greedy path-dependence rather than mesh error, and that also benignly explains the apparent test advantage. The deeper result is about the design procedure, not the mesh: with 6 design cases the objective is not identifiable (eps_sd/J_ref 1.01-2.52 at noise 0.05), which threatens every small-budget design conclusion in this project, not just this experiment.
limitations: Everything synthetic: real Belauri geography, synthetic emissions, winds and noise. Nothing empirically validated. Effective n is 2 independent decision comparisons, not 6, because budgets 3/5/8 are nested prefixes of one greedy trace. Noise 0.15 is uninformative for mesh. Budget 8 / noise 0.05 is excluded from stability claims. Test seed 303 is now burned and cannot be held-out for EXP-026. The 125 m arm was dropped although its registered stop condition (250 m stage over 4 h) was not met, and dt 25 was never run - both undeclared deviations. One of 142 interior candidates changes study category between meshes. Cluster numbers carry a ~5e-08 relative architecture floor vs laptop Phase 1-3 numbers (D-005), six orders below anything in play. Not verified by review: physics, solver internals, re-derivation of the CSVs from the layouts JSONs, the figures.
next_experiment: Pre-register an EXP-015 variant with the paired baseline and a dated amendment of the two-sided criterion to the one-sided form the hypothesis states, then run it. Do NOT start EXP-026 on the strength of a provisional admissibility unless the user accepts that risk explicitly.
unresolved: Whether mesh refinement actually moves sensor decisions - the registered test could not answer it. Requires the paired baseline: select layouts at 500 m AND 250 m on each of the 8 replicate draws so the two distributions are commensurable (about 8 extra 250 m ensembles, roughly 31 min at 8 workers on this cluster). Also unresolved: whether the design objective can be identified at all at 6 design cases, which is a procedure-level question affecting EXP-013, EXP-014, EXP-020 and EXP-026.
what_failed: The experiment did not test its own hypothesis. H1 is UNTESTED, not supported: every mesh selects from the same seed-101 design draws (zero case-draw variability) while each replicate uses a different draw (full case-draw variability), so the baseline carries a variance component the mesh comparison does not and a one-sided mesh<=baseline test cannot fail - a deliberately broken 2 km mesh would pass. The registered two-sided IQR criterion also yields no verdict, because all six failures are below the baseline floor rather than above the ceiling. Three of my initial claims were overturned by independent review: the 6-35 percent held-out advantage is a single-case artefact (no detectable difference at n=6); very flat objective was mis-diagnosed (the tie threshold eps_sd exceeds J_ref, so the real problem is non-identifiability at 6 cases); dt has no effect was over-scoped to 100 vs 50. I also missed that mesh regret is negative, falsifying the section 5 non-negativity expectation.
what_happened: Stage 2 production ran as RUN-0058 (slurm 201819, node004, 12 workers, exit 0, 1h10m32s, MaxRSS 2.6 GB). All 12 pre-registered artifacts retrieved and sha256-verified 12/12; the 721 MB response-basis cache was left on the cluster. Results: dt 100 and dt 50 select identical sites at both resolutions, so only mesh matters. At noise 0.05 the 500 m vs 250 m mean displacement is 2532 / 2771 / 607 m at budgets 3 / 5 / 8 with signed regret -11.5 / -9.2 / -6.8 percent of J_ref. At noise 0.15 all four configs select the identical layout at every budget. The replicate-pair baseline never reproduced a layout (0/28 identical pairs in all six cells), displacement 1000-6813 m.
what_worked: The Research OS HPC path end to end: measured preflight sizing (one 250 m/dt 50 case = 308 s) predicted the run almost exactly; 12 workers matched the 12 independent units; no test-set leakage (:289 asserts all layout files exist before :293 builds the test cases); alpha is an exact-equality assert against the frozen file; the noise scale is frozen and passed to workers by initargs; ensemble disjointness is machine-checked; the reserved fresh seed 304 was never touched. Writing the analysis script and identifying the baseline-mesh asymmetry BEFORE results existed meant the criteria could not drift.

interpretation: The Research OS to Duke Slurm path is verified end to end for submission, compute-node execution, exit status, retrieval, checksum integrity, dataset staging and the regression gate. Cluster cores are 2.2x slower than the laptop the published cost table was measured on, so every estimate in docs/hpc-runbook.md section 2 needed that correction. Useful parallelism is bounded by independent units, not cores: 12 for EXP-015 stage 2, 36 for EXP-026, and stage 2's final 31 minutes is single-threaded.
limitations: Infrastructure only; not a scientific result and must never be cited as one. One cluster, one partition (defq), two CPU families. The regression gate holds within an architecture only; cross-architecture bit-identity is not achievable and the ~5e-08 relative floor must be disclosed when cluster and laptop numbers are compared.

what_happened: Seven runs. RUN-0051 built the persistent cluster venv (Python 3.12.12, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, FiPy 4.0.3, matplotlib 3.11.2, full geo stack; pravah and ForwardSolver import). RUN-0054 failed on a missing data/belauri/manifest.json. RUN-0055 passed the gate against the new x86_64 baseline (21 files, 0 differ) and revealed that stage 2 also needs data/belauri/raw. RUN-0056 failed because the command used the system python3. RUN-0057 measured one 250 m/dt 50 reference design case at 308 s.
what_worked: Every failure was cheap and found a real gap before production allocation was spent. The bundle size guard refused a 2.1 GB working tree. The architecture-scoped regression gate (D-005) was established from evidence rather than by loosening a tolerance. The belauri-geography dataset was staged with all 10 manifest-referenced raw files verified against their already-recorded sha256 before and after transfer (10/10 both times) and now reports usable (checksum check, 39 files). scripts/hpc_link_datasets.sh makes the venv and the dataset path automatic so neither failure can recur. The 308 s measurement predicted the EXP-015 production run almost exactly.
